changes.description: Fast implementation of DEFLATE, gzip, and zlib
changes.note:
## `libdeflate` Version 1.26

- Added support for compression level `-1` as an alias for the default compression level (`6`).
- `libdeflate` now requires a C11 compiler.
- Fixed build failures with certain compilers and C libraries.
- Improved optimizations on certain architectures and variants.
